model_assumptions.rule: dues/stumpage rates are not delivered prices
model_assumptions.notes: Stumpage, dues, royalty and standing-value rates are charges on standing timber. They are not delivered log prices: a delivered price embeds harvest, haul, road and silviculture cost plus a margin. Subtracting the same cost stack from a scaled dues rate double counts those costs if the result is read as a mill margin. Rates also differ in unit, species/grade, tenure, scaling and vintage. Deltas are therefore method changes, not observed market changes.

national_comparison.notes: Volume-weighted diagnostic. A dues rate is not a delivered log price; the scaled-minus-donor-flat delta is a method effect, not an observed market change. No combined national net value is computed.

caveats: Evidence coverage comes first. The default view is the direct/reported, proxy and donor mix, not a national margin.
Donor-only jurisdictions are flagged provisional donor. Their margins are placeholders, not comparable provincial results, and the UI does not rank margins.
National values are volume-weighted model diagnostics shown last, not a combined national net value.
donor_flat is the base scenario. stumpage_scaled is the method sensitivity: the sensitivity, not the base; not observed and not policy grade.
Stumpage, dues, royalty and standing-value rates are charges on standing timber, not delivered log prices. The scaled-minus-donor-flat delta is a method change, not an observed market change.
No jurisdiction row is an observed transaction, policy-grade value, Forest LP input or public OSeCAN input.
non_claims: Not a Forest LP objective or constraint input.
Not a legal AAC or a policy frontier.
